criterio_pre_registrado.unidade: judgeable transect (list and offsets read from the judge output, not recomputed)
criterio_pre_registrado.correcao: Holm within the confirmatory family (2 tests) — unchanged by ANADEM
criterio_pre_registrado.metrica: NMAD per transect-band; difference = NMAD(a) - NMAD(b); negative = a is less dispersed
criterio_pre_registrado.poder: Power formula: MDE80 = (t_{1-alpha/2,n-1} + t_{0.80,n-1}) * dp/sqrt(n), with dp the standard deviation
criterio_pre_registrado.exploratorias: remaining bands and pairs (incl. v23 vs anadem): raw p, no verdict
criterio_pre_registrado.nota_metodologica: anadem column merged by quad+idx_no right after J.montar(), BEFORE any filter — it goes through the same filters/dedup/stratification as the other 5 products; does not interpret the result (script without claim prose)
